items.title: Maagh Maas Mahatmya (Glories of Magha Month)

content.shloka:
Māghe Māsi Gamiṣyanti Gaṅgā Yamunā Saṅgame
Gavāṁ Śata Sahasrasya Samyag Dattasya Yat Phalam
content.meaning: Those who bathe at the confluence of Ganga and Yamuna in the month of Magha obtain the merit equal to donating a hundred thousand cows.
content.transliteration:
Māghe Māsi Gamiṣyanti Gaṅgā Yamunā Saṅgame
Gavāṁ Śata Sahasrasya Samyag Dattasya Yat Phalam

content.shloka:
Māgha Snānaṁ Mahāpuṇyaṁ Sarva Pāpa Pranāśanam
Viṣṇu Prītikaraṁ Nityaṁ Mokṣadaṁ Puṇya Vardhanaṁ
content.meaning: Bathing in Magha is supremely meritorious, it destroys all sins, pleases Lord Vishnu eternally, grants liberation, and increases one's merit.
content.transliteration:
Māgha Snānaṁ Mahāpuṇyaṁ Sarva Pāpa Pranāśanam
Viṣṇu Prītikaraṁ Nityaṁ Mokṣadaṁ Puṇya Vardhanam

content.shloka:
Māgha Māse Mahādevo Yathā Tuṣyati Śaṅkaraḥ
Tathā Na Tuṣyate Māso Anyaḥ Kaścana Bhūtale
content.meaning: As Lord Shankara is pleased in the month of Magha, no other month on earth can please Him as much.
content.transliteration:
Māgha Māse Mahādevo Yathā Tuṣyati Śaṅkaraḥ
Tathā Na Tuṣyate Māso Anyaḥ Kaścana Bhūtale

content.shloka:
Sarva Tīrtheṣu Yat Puṇyaṁ Sarva Yajñeṣu Yat Phalam
Tat Phalaṁ Koṭi Guṇitaṁ Māgha Snāne Prajāyate
content.meaning: Whatever merit is in all pilgrimages, whatever fruit is in all sacrifices — that fruit, multiplied a million times, arises from bathing in Magha.
content.transliteration:
Sarva Tīrtheṣu Yat Puṇyaṁ Sarva Yajñeṣu Yat Phalam
Tat Phalaṁ Koṭi Guṇitaṁ Māgha Snāne Prajāyate

content.shloka:
Prātaḥ Kāle Samutthāya Snānaṁ Kuryāt Naro Budhaḥ
Sūrya Udaye Japaṁ Kuryāt Māgha Māsa Vidhānataḥ
content.meaning: A wise person should rise at dawn and perform the bathing ritual, then recite mantras at sunrise according to the prescribed method of Magha month.
content.transliteration:
Prātaḥ Kāle Samutthāya Snānaṁ Kuryāt Naro Budhaḥ
Sūrya Udaye Japaṁ Kuryāt Māgha Māsa Vidhānataḥ

content.shloka:
Gaṅgā Yamunayoḥ Snānaṁ Māghe Māsi Viśeṣataḥ
Prayāga Rāja Tīrthe Vā Anyatra Nadī Taṭe
content.meaning: Bathing in the Ganga, Yamuna, or especially at the sacred site of Prayagaraj, or at the banks of other holy rivers in Magha is especially meritorious.
content.transliteration:
Gaṅgā Yamunayoḥ Snānaṁ Māghe Māsi Viśeṣataḥ
Prayāga Rāja Tīrthe Vā Anyatra Nadī Taṭe

content.shloka:
Om Gaṅge Cha Yamune Chaiva Godāvarī Sarasvatī
Narmade Sindhu Kāverī Jalesmin Sannidhiṁ Kuru
content.meaning: O Ganga, Yamuna, Godavari, Sarasvati, Narmada, Sindhu, and Kaveri — please be present in this water.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Gaṅge Ca Yamune Caiva Godāvarī Sarasvatī
Narmade Sindhu Kāverī Jalesmin Sannidhiṁ Kuru

content.shloka:
Snāna Saṅkalpa: Mama Samasta Pāpa Kṣayārthaṁ
Śrī Viṣṇu Prītyarthaṁ Māgha Māsa Snānam Ahaṁ Kariṣye
content.meaning: Bathing resolve: For the destruction of all my sins and for the pleasure of Lord Vishnu, I shall perform the Magha month bathing ritual.
content.transliteration:
Snāna Saṅkalpa: Mama Samasta Pāpa Kṣayārthaṁ
Śrī Viṣṇu Prītyarthaṁ Māgha Māsa Snānam Ahaṁ Kariṣye

content.shloka:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa Uvāca:
Śṛṇu Dharmarāja Vīra Māgha Māsa Mahāphalam
Yena Vijñāta Mātreṇa Sarvapāpaiḥ Pramucyate
content.meaning: Lord Krishna said: O brave Dharmaraja, hear the great fruit of Magha month. By merely knowing its significance, one is freed from all sins.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa Uvāca:
Śṛṇu Dharmarāja Vīra Māgha Māsa Mahāphalam
Yena Vijñāta Mātreṇa Sarvapāpaiḥ Pramucyate

content.shloka:
Purā Dilīpa Nāmnā Vai Rājā Āsīt Mahīpatiḥ
Māgha Snāna Parō Nityaṁ Dharmiṣṭhaḥ Satyavāk Śuciḥ
content.meaning: Once there was a king named Dilipa, ruler of the earth, who was devoted to Magha bathing daily — righteous, truthful, and pure.
content.transliteration:
Purā Dilīpa Nāmnā Vai Rājā Āsīt Mahīpatiḥ
Māgha Snāna Parō Nityaṁ Dharmiṣṭhaḥ Satyavāk Śuciḥ

content.shloka:
Tasya Puṇya Prabhāvena Svarga Loka Samāptavān
Viṣṇu Sāyujyam Āpnoti Māgha Snānasya Vai Phalam
content.meaning: By the power of his merit, he attained the heavenly realms. The fruit of Magha bathing is attaining union with Lord Vishnu.
content.transliteration:
Tasya Puṇya Prabhāvena Svarga Loka Samāptavān
Viṣṇu Sāyujyam Āpnoti Māgha Snānasya Vai Phalam

content.shloka:
Tasmāt Sarva Prayatnena Māghe Snānaṁ Samācaret
Vrat Kathā Śravaṇāt Puṇyaṁ Sarva Kāma Phalapradam
content.meaning: Therefore, one should make every effort to bathe in Magha. By hearing this Vrat Katha, one earns merit that fulfills all desires.
content.transliteration:
Tasmāt Sarva Prayatnena Māghe Snānaṁ Samācaret
Vrat Kathā Śravaṇāt Puṇyaṁ Sarva Kāma Phalapradam

content.shloka:
Māghe Māsi Mahādānaṁ Tiladānaṁ Viśeṣataḥ
Ghṛta Dhānyaṁ Ca Vastāṇi Dānaṁ Mokṣa Phalapradam
content.meaning: In the month of Magha, great charity is prescribed, especially the gift of sesame seeds. Giving ghee, grain, and clothes yields the fruit of liberation.
content.transliteration:
Māghe Māsi Mahādānaṁ Tiladānaṁ Viśeṣataḥ
Ghṛta Dhānyaṁ Ca Vastāṇi Dānaṁ Mokṣa Phalapradam

content.shloka:
Anna Dānaṁ Paraṁ Dānaṁ Vidyā Dānaṁ Tataḥ Param
Māghe Dattaṁ Ca Yaddānaṁ Tat Sarvaṁ Akṣayaṁ Bhavet
content.meaning: The gift of food is a supreme gift, and the gift of knowledge is even greater. Whatever charity is given in Magha becomes inexhaustible.
content.transliteration:
Anna Dānaṁ Paraṁ Dānaṁ Vidyā Dānaṁ Tataḥ Param
Māghe Dattaṁ Ca Yaddānaṁ Tat Sarvaṁ Akṣayaṁ Bhavet

content.shloka:
Tila Dāne Viśeṣeṇa Māghe Yat Kriyate Naraiḥ
Tat Sarvam Akṣayaṁ Proktaṁ Śrī Viṣṇoḥ Vachanāt Mune
content.meaning: The gift of sesame seeds especially made in Magha by mortals — all of it is declared inexhaustible by the words of Lord Vishnu, O sage.
content.transliteration:
Tila Dāne Viśeṣeṇa Māghe Yat Kriyate Naraiḥ
Tat Sarvam Akṣayaṁ Proktaṁ Śrī Viṣṇoḥ Vacanāt Mune

content.shloka:
Kurvīta Dānaṁ Viprāya Gāvō Bhūmi Suvarṇakam
Māgha Dāna Phalaṁ Divyaṁ Svarga Mokṣa Pradāyakam
content.meaning: One should give charity of cows, land, and gold to Brahmins. The divine fruit of Magha charity bestows heaven and liberation.
content.transliteration:
Kurvīta Dānaṁ Viprāya Gāvō Bhūmi Suvarṇakam
Māgha Dāna Phalaṁ Divyaṁ Svarga Mokṣa Pradāyakam

content.shloka:
Māgha Śukla Ekādaśī Jayā Nāma Mahāvratam
Viṣṇu Prītikaraṁ Puṇyaṁ Sarva Pāpa Vināśanam
content.meaning: The Ekadashi of Magha Shukla, known as Jaya Ekadashi, is a great vow that pleases Lord Vishnu, is meritorious, and destroys all sins.
content.transliteration:
Māgha Śukla Ekādaśī Jayā Nāma Mahāvratam
Viṣṇu Prītikaraṁ Puṇyaṁ Sarva Pāpa Vināśanam

content.shloka:
Upavāsaṁ Naraḥ Kuryāt Ekādaśyāṁ Jitendriyaḥ
Viṣṇu Pūjāṁ Prakurvīta Tulasī Dala Saṁyutam
content.meaning: A person of controlled senses should observe fasting on Ekadashi, and worship Lord Vishnu with Tulasi leaves.
content.transliteration:
Upavāsaṁ Naraḥ Kuryāt Ekādaśyāṁ Jitendriyaḥ
Viṣṇu Pūjāṁ Prakurvīta Tulasī Dala Saṁyutam

content.shloka:
Dvādaśyāṁ Pāraṇaṁ Kuryāt Brāhmaṇān Bhojayed Budhaḥ
Māgha Kṛṣṇa Ekādaśī Ṣaṭtilā Nāma Viśrutā
content.meaning: On Dvadashi one should break the fast and feed Brahmins. The Ekadashi of Magha Krishna paksha is well-known as Shattila Ekadashi.
content.transliteration:
Dvādaśyāṁ Pāraṇaṁ Kuryāt Brāhmaṇān Bhojayed Budhaḥ
Māgha Kṛṣṇa Ekādaśī Ṣaṭtilā Nāma Viśrutā

content.shloka:
Ṣaṭ Tilāḥ Ṣaḍ Vidhaiḥ Sevyāḥ Snāne Dāne Tathā Jape
Havane Bhojane Chaiva Lepane Ṣaṭ Tilā Smṛtāḥ
content.meaning: Six types of sesame usage are prescribed: in bathing, charity, chanting, fire offerings, eating, and anointing — thus is Shattila observed.
content.transliteration:
Ṣaṭ Tilāḥ Ṣaḍ Vidhaiḥ Sevyāḥ Snāne Dāne Tathā Jape
Havane Bhojane Caiva Lepane Ṣaṭ Tilā Smṛtāḥ

content.shloka:
Om Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāya
Māgha Māsa Adhiṣṭhāna Devatābhyo Namaḥ
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Lord Vasudeva. Salutations to the presiding deities of Magha month.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāya
Māgha Māsa Adhiṣṭhāna Devatābhyo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Om Hrīṁ Śrīṁ Klīṁ Mādhavāya Namaḥ
Māgha Pūrṇimāyāṁ Viṣṇuṁ Sampūjya Phalaṁ Aśnute
content.meaning: Om Hrim Shrim Klim, salutations to Madhava. By worshipping Vishnu on Magha Purnima, one attains the fruit.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Hrīṁ Śrīṁ Klīṁ Mādhavāya Namaḥ
Māgha Pūrṇimāyāṁ Viṣṇuṁ Sampūjya Phalaṁ Aśnute

content.shloka:
Om Sūryāya Namaḥ Om Viṣṇave Namaḥ
Māgha Māse Japennityaṁ Sūrya Mantraṁ Vimuktaye
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Surya. Om, salutations to Vishnu. One should daily chant the Surya mantra in Magha month for liberation.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Sūryāya Namaḥ Oṁ Viṣṇave Namaḥ
Māgha Māse Japennityaṁ Sūrya Mantraṁ Vimuktaye

content.shloka:
Om Tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ Bhargo Devasya Dhīmahi
Dhiyo Yo Naḥ Prachodayāt
Gāyatrī Japa Vidhānaṁ Māghe Viśeṣataḥ
content.meaning: Om, let us meditate on that excellent glory of the divine Sun. May He illuminate our intellect. The chanting of Gayatri is especially prescribed in Magha.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ Bhargo Devasya Dhīmahi
Dhiyo Yo Naḥ Pracodayāt
Gāyatrī Japa Vidhānaṁ Māghe Viśeṣataḥ
